notes.title: 3/14 Update: Ver. 0.2.1 Update
notes.content:
[b]Ver 0.2.1 Update details[/b]

1. Countermeasure for the player gimmick that causes the player to be stuck in the stage. 
2. Fixed a problem with the breakable floor in the “Freezer” area. 
3. Corrected the area [Freezer] breakable floor to regenerate depending on the time.
4. Fixed the animation of the area field gimmick “rotating spikes
5. Shortened the interval for players to merge with each other after respawning
6. Other minor stage fixes

notes.title: Ver 0.2.0 UpDate!
notes.content:
Ver 0.2.0 Update Contents

1. addition of new area
　A new area, 【PLAY ROOM】was added. It consists of 6 stages. 2.
2. addition of new field gimmicks
　A new field gimmick “JumpBoard” has been added along with the addition of 【PLAY ROOM】. 3.
3. partial modification of 【SPACE SHIP】 area
　A tutorial stage for the player gimmick “Attract” has been added.

There was an error in the announcement regarding the previous update.
　It was listed as Ver. 1.0.3 update, but the correct version is 0.1.3.
　We apologize for the correction.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: ver 1.0.3 Update Notes
notes.content:
[b]1. Added and Updated Keyboard Controls[/b]
Added instructions and modified some key mappings:
Arrow Keys Up/Down: Switch between gimmicks
Arrow Keys Left/Right: Change gimmick position
Hold Q Key: Detach

[b]2. Improved Clear Time Display[/b]
Clear time now displays values between 0.01 seconds and 99 minutes.

[b]3. UI Improvements[/b]
Enhanced the control instructions UI for better clarity.
Adjusted tutorial text in the SpaceShip stage.

[b]4. Bug Fixes[/b]
Fixed an issue where characters behaved unexpectedly after respawning while merged.
Resolved several bugs in the Freezer stage.

notes.title: Update on October 29
notes.content:
The problem that prevented players from joining in local multiplayer has been fixed.
At the same time, we have confirmed that the issue with Remote Play Together has also been resolved.
